newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds and futures continued to hold steady or firm at close.
Traders said business was shaped strongly by roll-over activities ahead of next Monday's expiry of the September Conf government future and the spread between September and December Conf narrowed.
Two-year Swiss franc swaps were unchanged at 2.72/80 percent. Five-year swaps dropped one basis point to 3.72/80 and ten-year swaps were also down one at 4.49/57.
Sept conf bond CONFU6 up 6 basis points at 113.60.
Sept comi medium-term bond COMIU6 down 1 at 109.59.
Sept Euro Swiss francs FESU6 up two at 97.84. -- Cash:
